dataset_name: ISRO / NRSC Bhuvan Flood Inundation & Hazard Maps
source_agency: National Remote Sensing Centre (NRSC), Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)
temporal_resolution: Event-based (satellite pass frequency, typically 2-6 days during flood activations)
license_or_access_notes: Bhuvan Open Data / Disaster Management Support Programme (DMSP). OGC WMS/WFS map services and event PDF/GIS vector bulletins.
notes: ISRO/NRSC provides optical and microwave SAR inundation delineation during major flood events. Critical limitation: satellite observations are discrete snapshot passes, not continuous daily coverage. Cloud cover obstructs optical sensors, making SAR essential.
